title: E5 Precision Eyeshadow Brush
descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Vegan
What it is: A detail brush for the perfect smoky eyeuse it to apply and blend shadows and to smoke out liner along the lash line.

Brush Formulation: All formulas

Coverage: Buildable

Handle Length: 4.3 inches

Bristle Type: Synthetic

Ingredient Callouts: This product is cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This brush’s small, tapered head makes it the perfect detail brush. Use it to apply shadows wet or dry or to blend and smoke out eyeliner with control and ease. All Makeup By Mario brushes are cruelty-free, made with a custom blend of synthetic and vegan fibers, and 100% FSC-certified birchwood handles.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Use it to apply shadow along the upper and lower lash line.
-Use it to apply shadow to any detailed areas of the eye, including the inner and outer corners and the brow bone. You can also use it for detailed crease application and to smoke shadows along the upper and lower lash line.
-Use wet with Master Metallics™ and Master Metals™ (each sold separately) for a beautiful, intense payoff.
